text: The Waterworks Discoveries is a delve achievement earned by finding and opening all Sturdy Chests hidden in the Waterworks.
The Waterworks Stories is a delve achievement earned by completing each story variant of the Waterworks.

The War Within Season 2 (or Season 39) is the second season for both PvP and PvE that launched alongside the opening of Liberation of Undermine, a new raid from patch 11.1.0 that opened on 4 March 2025.
The Whole Brass Band is a customization for the G-99 Breakneck, available at honored standing with the Venture Company in Undermine.
The Weeping Vilomah is a roc summoned by speaking to Boomhooch the Lost in a cave accessed from Bluefeather Cliffs in Thaldraszus.

The War Within Season 1: Spelunker Supreme is awarded to characters who complete at least one end-game task during The War Within Season 1. It awards a Mark of the Spelunker Supreme, sent via in-game mail from Thaumaturge Vashreen:

The War Within Season 2: Master Blaster is awarded to characters who complete at least one end-game task during The War Within Season 2. It awards the Crystallized Essence of Kaja'mite, containing an Essence of Kaja'mite charge for the Catalyst.

The Winter Queen's Forest is located near Procrastimond in Elsewhen. It can be matched with the Rune of Suffering, where the Prophecy of Verdant Winter serves as a hint.
The War Within Season 3 (or Season 40) is the third season for both PvP and PvE that launched alongside the opening of Manaforge Omega, a new raid from patch 11.2.0 that opened on 12 August 2025.

The War Within Season 3: Voidborne Victor is awarded to characters who complete at least one end-game task during The War Within Season 3. It awards the Crystallized Ethereal Voidsplinter, containing an Ethereal Voidsplinter charge for the Catalyst.
The Wrong Bluecephalus starts the third day of questing to acquire the Blue Barry (mount) mount. To begin, reach Renown 9 with the K'aresh Trust and find Ba'eth in Tazavesh.

"Through the Roof of the World" is the main theme of World of Warcraft: Shadowlands. It was composed and arranged by Glenn Stafford; features additional music by Neal Acree, David Arkenstone, Grant Kirkhope, and Jake Lefkowitz; and includes classic World of Warcraft themes by Jason Hayes.

Three Ranks Higher is the third in a series of Liberation of Undermine achievements involving hard mode on the One-Armed Bandit boss. There are four colored chips found inside the Gallagio while on the way to the One-Armed Bandit. After collecting one (or more) coins, take them to the slot machines in the room immediately before the boss arena and interact with the same-colored machine to deposit the coin and alter the encounter. In order of increasing difficulty, activate red, gold, blue, then purple chips in that order.

The Thunder-Ridged Elekk is a fel-corrupted elekk mount obtainable from a promotion with and [https://www.instagram.com/p/DV0GAq7jeZ9/ Jung von Matt Nerd] that started on 13 March 2026. The promotion involved players locating QR codes at physical locations in Germany, which would take them to the promotional website where they could obtain a code for the mount. The promotion was intended to last until 26 March, but was effectively over within 24 hours; the QR code turned out to be unnecessary as users could simply access the promotional website directly, there was no protection against earning multiple codes, and there were only 3,000 codes available which were not restricted to the account

Thunderlord's Crackling Citrine is a gem that can be slotted into the Singing Thunder Socket on Cyrce's Circlet. It is a reward for completing the The Drain vignette for the 1st time. After a character has obtained the citrine for the first time, they can also purchase this item for 50 Flame-Blessed Iron from Didi the Wrench on the Siren Isle.
__NOTOC__ Thunder Talek is an armoredon that spawns to attack Clan Aylaag's caravan when the Aylaag Camp moves to a new location on the Ohn'ahran Plains.
__NOTOC__ Thunderlord Butchers are orcs located in Frostfire Ridge.
__NOTOC__ Thunderous Hide is a hide leatherworking crafting reagent obtained by players with the skinning skill.
Thunderous Drums is created with Khaz Algar Leatherworking. The crafting recipe can be learned from Leatherworking trainers in Khaz Algar upon reaching Khaz Algar Leatherworking (50).

Thunderbund of Fallen Storms can be obtained by converting another The War Within Season 3 belt using the Catalyst. It is part of the Crash of Fallen Storms set but is not required to benefit from the tier bonus.
